source_read: IKEA UK item pages (https://www.ikea.com/gb/en/food/salesareas/{restaurant,bistro,swedish-cafe,swedish-bite,swedish-deli}/ and 203 item pages), downloaded afresh 2026-10-08 (robots.txt allows /gb/en/food/); 14 item pages also rendered in Chromium and the visible nutrition table and ingredients/allergens read
notes: All 126 rows x 8 per-portion values re-read from the page JSON by description (not by the script's codes) and checked against per-100 g x portion weight: 0 differences; 14 rendered pages match. data/source/ikea had never been regenerated since ikea.py gained allergens/kJ (the script also stopped on 'WHEAT GLUTEN'): fixed ikea.py (own spellings, bold words after 'may contain' are traces, raw may-contain so tree-nut kinds are dropped per policy 2, structured-only marks recorded) and re-ran it, so allergens.csv + kJ + weight are now published. Hot dogs, Swedish Special and Potato scone gain a may-contain (soya / nuts) that the page prints only in ingredient text. Latte, Cappuccino, Black Pudding: printed kJ contradicts kcal while kcal matches protein+carbs+fat, so the dish is kept and the kJ is not published (policy 1). The 8 existing held-back dishes (kcal vs macros impossible) unchanged.
